title.purpose: Card titles (h2) and plate card titles.

note.purpose: Secondary text, hints, table body, field help.

label.purpose: Mono chips, pills, status chips, tab numerals, preview meta.

wordmark.purpose: VAULT in the top bar; the only tracked-out caps.

mono.purpose: Measured dimensions such as the W x D x H line.

shadows.name: menu-shadow
shadows.purpose: Popover menus. Dark theme deepens all three steps to 30-40% black.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default (outline) action: Bench Paper fill, hairline border, control shadow, 0.375rem corner; hover takes the Teal Wash.
components.css: .ds-btn{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2.25rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286));border-radius:calc(var(--radius, .5rem) - 2px);background:var(--background, oklch(0.975 0.003 90));color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px oklch(0.21 0.006 286 / 8%));cursor:pointer} .ds-btn:hover{background:var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.03 190));color:var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.35 0.06 195))} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The chosen or committed action: Bench Ink fill with the primary shadow. Also the pressed state of a segmented control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2.25rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));border-radius:calc(var(--radius, .5rem) - 2px);background:var(--primary, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));color:var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.002 90));font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;box-shadow:var(--shadow, 0 1px 3px oklch(0.21 0.006 286 / 10%));cursor:pointer} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)) 90%, var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.002 90)))} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet header action: no fill, no border, Teal Wash on hover. Save and Load wear it at the small size.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2rem;padding:.25rem .6rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:calc(var(--radius, .5rem) - 2px);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer} .ds-btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.03 190));color:var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.35 0.06 195))} .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Chip
components.description: Round mono label chip. Selected is Pressed Grey; the teal pill carries facts like backbone.
components.css: .ds-chip-row{display:inline-flex;gap:.5rem} .ds-chip{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;line-height:1.45;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.375rem;padding:.125rem .625rem;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286));border-radius:999px;background:var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.002 90));color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.012 286));font-size:.75rem} .ds-chip-teal{background:var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.03 190));color:var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.35 0.06 195));border-color:var(--teal, oklch(0.52 0.07 195))}

components.name: Printer Toggle
components.description: Export-row printer selector: name plus bed size in small mono. Selected is Teal Wash with a Bench Teal border.
components.css: .ds-ptoggle{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286));border-radius:calc(var(--radius, .5rem) - 2px);background:var(--background, oklch(0.975 0.003 90));color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));padding:.5rem 1rem;font-size:.875rem;cursor:pointer} .ds-ptoggle:hover{border-color:var(--teal, oklch(0.52 0.07 195))} .ds-ptoggle-on{border-color:var(--teal, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));background:var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.03 190));color:var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.35 0.06 195))} .ds-pmono{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;font-size:.75rem;opacity:.7} .ds-ptoggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Non-interactive state report in mono Pencil Grey (enabled printers in the header).
components.css: .ds-status{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;line-height:1.45;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:.125rem .5rem;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286));border-radius:999px;background:var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.002 90));color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.012 286));font-size:.75rem;cursor:default}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Input with a 500-weight label above, Field Edge border, control shadow, 2.25rem tall.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:.5rem;color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500} .ds-input{font:inherit;font-weight:400;color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));border:1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.62 0.008 286));background:var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.002 90));border-radius:calc(var(--radius, .5rem) - 2px);padding:.5rem .75rem;min-height:2.25rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px oklch(0.21 0.006 286 / 8%))} .ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Switch
components.description: Round 2.25rem × 1.25rem toggle; off is a 22% ink tint, on is Bench Ink, with a Bench Paper thumb.
components.css: .ds-switch-row{display:inline-flex;gap:.6rem} .ds-switch{position:relative;width:2.25rem;height:1.25rem;padding:0;border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)) 22%, transparent);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px oklch(0.21 0.006 286 / 8%));cursor:pointer} .ds-switch span{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:1rem;height:1rem;border-radius:999px;background:var(--background, oklch(0.975 0.003 90));box-shadow:0 2px 4px oklch(0.21 0.006 286 / 25%)} .ds-switch-on{background:var(--primary, oklch(0.21 0.006 286))} .ds-switch-on span{left:calc(100% - 1rem)} .ds-switch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Step Tabs
components.description: Tabs in the sticky shell: small mono numeral at 60% opacity, selected is Bench Ink at weight 500 with a 2px Bench Teal underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;display:flex;gap:.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286))} .ds-tabs button{font:inherit;font-size:.875rem;background:transparent;border:none;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.012 286));padding:.625rem 1rem;min-height:2.5rem;cursor:pointer} .ds-tabnum{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;font-size:.75rem;opacity:.6;margin-right:.375rem} .ds-tabs .ds-tab-on{color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));border-bottom-color:var(--teal, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));font-weight:500} .ds-tabs button:not(.ds-tab-on):hover{color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286))} .ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.07 195));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Card
components.description: Card Stock surface, hairline border, 1.5rem padding, no shadow; 0.875rem semibold title.
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;background:var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.002 90));color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286));border-radius:var(--radius, .5rem);padding:1.5rem;max-width:24rem} .ds-card-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1rem} .ds-card h2{margin:0;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600} .ds-note{margin:0;color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.012 286));font-size:.875rem}

components.css: .ds-layer{font-family:var(--font, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);line-height:1.45;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;background:var(--background, oklch(0.975 0.003 90));border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286));border-radius:calc(var(--radius, .5rem) - 2px);padding:.625rem .75rem;color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286));max-width:26rem} .ds-grip{color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.012 286));cursor:grab;flex:none} .ds-layer-name{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;font:inherit;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;background:transparent;border:none;padding:.35rem .2rem;min-height:2.25rem;color:inherit;cursor:pointer} .ds-layer-sum{font-size:.86rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.012 286))} .ds-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:.125rem .625rem;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.91 0.004 286));border-radius:999px;background:var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.002 90));color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.52 0.012 286));font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;font-size:.75rem} .ds-layer-open{background:var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.03 190));border-color:var(--teal, oklch(0.52 0.07 195))}

components.name: Filament Swatch
components.description: Signature: the one place colour is allowed. A 2.5rem square on piece cards, overlapping 1rem dots in the header, a 2.25rem colour disc picker in Settings.
components.css: .ds-sw-row{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem} .ds-swatch{width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;border-radius:calc(var(--radius, .5rem) - 4px);border:1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.62 0.008 286))} .ds-dots{display:inline-flex} .ds-dot{width:1rem;height:1rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)) 15%, transparent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.002 90));margin-left:-.25rem} .ds-dot:first-child{margin-left:0} .ds-disc{width:2.25rem;height:2.25rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 286)) 15%, transparent)}

narrative.overview:
A clean workbench that lets the user's own filament colours and the designer's real renders be the loudest colour in the room. The chrome is warm off-white paper, ink-dark text, and hairline rules under a sticky, blurred header; the one accent is a muted teal that means "this is selected or in progress": the current tab, the open layer, a plate marked printed, the focus ring. A switch that is on is ink-filled, like a primary button. Everything else that carries colour is data: a swatch, a drawer front in the stack preview, a part on a plate bed. When the interface stays this quiet, a wrong number or an unprintable part is the loudest thing on screen.

The mood is calm, precise and restrained, at an airier scale than the bench's first rendition: a centred 80rem column, 1.5rem card padding and 2rem column gaps (the rendition pinned from the "Vault Configurator UI prototype" on Lovable, ported 2026-11). Density is still real, because this is a planner with part lists, plate beds and printer fleets, but it is held together by hairline borders, a three-step shadow scale on controls only, and consistent control heights rather than by decoration. Icons are a single 2px-stroke set drawn inline, used only where they name an action.

This is an independent tool with a neutral identity (see PRODUCT.md). Nothing here borrows the VAULT or USSA Design look.
keyCharacteristics: Colour belongs to the user's filaments; the UI itself is paper, ink and one teal that marks selection and state.
Cards are flat with hairline borders; controls carry a small resting shadow so editable things read as objects on the bench.
Hairline borders do the structural work that fills and shadows do elsewhere.
Plex Sans for prose and controls; Plex Mono for the wordmark, chips, counts and measured dimensions.
Light and dark themes share one set of semantic token names and one warm-neutral hue family, each composed on its own.
Desktop-first, mouse and keyboard; breakpoints at 1100px (preview narrows), 900px (one column) and 640px (tight gutters).

rules.name: The Filaments-First Colour Rule
rules.body: The loudest hue on any screen is a filament colour (swatches, dots, plate parts, the stack preview). The interface adds only Bench Teal, and only to mark selection, state or focus. Do not introduce a second accent.

rules.name: The Quiet Wash Rule
rules.body: Caution, Fault and Confirmed colour text. Only a full-width message line may also carry the matching faint wash, with no border, no icon and no saturated fill. A warning is still a sentence, not a banner.

rules.name: The Millimetre Rule
rules.body: Measured dimensions, sizes and coordinates are set in Plex Mono so figures align and read as data; the same mono carries the wordmark, chips, tab numerals and counts — short data labels only. Prose never uses it.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside a row is weight (500 or 600), never a larger size.

rules.name: The One Column Collapse Rule
rules.body: Below 900px every multi-column grid becomes a single column in source order. The 1100px preview narrowing is the one intermediate step.

rules.name: The Flat-Cards Rule
rules.body: Surfaces and cards are flat at rest and nothing lifts on hover. Shadows belong to controls and menus only. Hover is a colour or border change (a button takes the Teal Wash, a piece card takes a teal edge, an inactive tab darkens to ink), never a movement.

dos: **Do** let colour come from filaments and renders. A swatch, a dot, a plate part or a drawer front is where a saturated hue belongs; Bench Teal marks selection and state beside them.
**Do** separate surfaces with a 1px Hairline border and a tonal step (Paper, Card Stock, Recess). Keep shadows on controls and menus, from the three-step scale only.
**Do** keep controls on the 2.25rem rhythm (small header size 2rem, tabs 2.5rem) and corners on the one radius scale (0.25 / 0.375 / 0.5rem) so rows align across the page.
**Do** set measured dimensions, chips and counts in IBM Plex Mono and state limits with the number ("329.6 mm wide", not "too big").
**Do** use the inline 2px-stroke icon set where an icon names the action (save, load, add, export); pair it with a text label on buttons.
**Do** report faults as a short Caution or Fault sentence beside the control that caused it; give a blocking full-width message its faint wash.
**Do** keep a visible 2px Bench Teal focus ring on every interactive element; this is a keyboard-and-mouse desk tool.
**Do** take every colour from the token set so light and dark both work. Add a token before adding a literal.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent colour, gradients, glow, or decorative coloured backgrounds on panels. Tinted backgrounds are limited to the three signal washes on message lines and Teal Wash on the documented selected, open and hover states.
**Don't** use Caution, Fault or Confirmed as saturated fills, borders, left-edge stripes or banners; they colour text, and a message line may add its faint wash.
**Don't** lift on hover, shadow a card, or add shadow steps beyond the three named ones.
**Don't** introduce a display typeface or a size jump to show emphasis; use weight.
**Don't** import the look of the VAULT product or USSA Design (logo, palette, imagery as chrome); the identity stays neutral and independent.
**Don't** use emoji or text glyphs (`×`, `←`, `+`) as icons, or icons as ornament; the interface carries data.
**Don't** hard-code a colour in a component's CSS for UI chrome. The only literal colours in code are fallbacks for filament data (`#c9ccd0`, `#ccc`).
**Don't** design for touch or narrow screens beyond the documented 1100 / 900 / 640px steps unless the product brief changes.
